corrections.text: The article quoted InfoQ as saying the increase in resolved issues was "significantly lower than the 30% code increase." InfoQ's actual wording is: "this is significantly smaller than the estimated 30% increase in lines of code."

The article attributed to Undo CEO Greg Law, via InfoQ, the quote "while agents excel at rapid code generation, they demonstrate less capability in debugging." The actual quote, per InfoQ, is: "while agents are great at writing reams of code quickly, they're less capable at debugging it."

The article quoted LeadDev managing editor Michael Hill as saying "Humans are now well beyond capacity to easily read, review, and understand the flood of PRs." The actual quote, per SD Times, is: "Humans are now well beyond their capacity to easily read, review, and understand the flood of PRs and the massive size of changes AI can create."
